title: Testing Python Backend Applications
description: Build a fast test pyramid around services, repositories, HTTP routes, and authentication.
learningOutcomes: Use pytest fixtures and parametrization well
Separate unit and integration test responsibilities
Isolate databases and test async authenticated applications

lessons.title: Unit Tests and Mocking
lessons.description: Test services without reproducing framework internals.
